33001.story: As of Oct 12, the record on the middle value of the county's 7 grids runs from 1951 to 2025, and May to June came in under 90% of normal in 37 of those 75 years. In 2025, July to August on the middle of the grids came in at 37% of normal, and August to September at 53%. So far in 2026, May to June on the middle of the grids came in at 156% of normal. Grid 28734 had its driest year in 2001 at 72%, while the other grids had theirs in 1965.

preliminary.means: an estimate from NOAA rain, not RMA's index; RMA's final index can differ

On the middle value of the county's 6 grids, May to June came in under 90% of normal in 39 years, the most of any pair.
